prompts.prompt: In the skill-builder pipeline's curation standards, at how many lines does a skill body's length become a hard fail rather than merely above target? Answer concisely with the number.
prompts.source: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/skill-builder/SKILL.md - Body. 200-500 lines is the target; 1,000 is a hard fail.

prompts.prompt: In the skill-builder pipeline, which model tier does the single curator agent that writes the finished skill run on? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/skill-builder/SKILL.md - the curator runs model: opus (the strongest reasoning model the harness offers)

prompts.prompt: In skill-builder's frontmatter guidance, what character count is treated as the absolute ceiling for a skill's description field, even when overlap disambiguation genuinely demands extra length? Answer concisely with the number.
prompts.source: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/skill-builder/SKILL.md - repo median is ~530 characters, p90 ~890. Stay under ~900 unless overlap disambiguation genuinely demands more; treat 1,500 as the ceiling.

costPolicy: claude: CLI-reported cost_usd. codex/pi: estimated from matrix.config.json pricing rates; null rates -> cost omitted, never guessed. local lane: $0.
